description: Source code for RAR PDU encoding and assembly in a 3GPP LTE/NR context, including classes for encoding RAR PDUs and assembling them into buffers.

classes.name: rar_pdu_encoder
classes.description: Handles encoding of RAR Protocol Data Units (PDUs) into byte buffers according to 3GPP TS38.321 specifications.

classes.name: rar_pdu_assembler
classes.description: Responsible for assembling RAR PDUs into buffers for transmission, utilizing rar_pdu_encoder.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes RAR grants into the provided output buffer.

methods.name: encode_rar_subpdu
methods.description: Encodes individual RAR sub-PDU including header and payload.

methods.name: encode_rapid_subheader
methods.description: Encodes the subheader for a RAR sub-PDU.

methods.name: encode_rar_grant_payload
methods.description: Encodes the payload of a RAR grant, including timing advance, frequency, MCS, TPC, CSI, and C-RNTI.

methods.name: encode_rar_pdu
methods.description: Encodes a complete RAR PDU from given RAR information into a buffer.
